To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a novel neural image captioning model that can learn to attend to relevant parts of the input image while generating a sequence of words that describe the input image.

1) attention is an effective way to improve the performance of neural image caption generators; 2) we can train the attention model with standard backpropagation; and 3) we can train it in a stochastic manner by maximizing a variatonal lower bound.

1) attention can be learned in a deterministic and stochastic manner, 2) attention is an important component of the model, and 3) the model is able learn a visual attention mechanism that is able to fix its gaze to salient regions of the image.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) How can we use attention to automatically describe the content of an image?
two questions: (1) How can we generate natural language descriptions of images?
the problem of generating descriptions of images using a deep recurrent neural network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model outperforms all previous work on image captioning.
our model outperforms all other methods on Flickr8k and Flickr30k and is competitive on MS COCO.
this paper proposes a model that can be trained in a deterministic manner by using standard backpropogation and also in a stochastic manner by maximizing a variation lower bound.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the model is able learn to attend to salient regions in an image, while generating semantically meaningful captions.
we have introduced a new attention based neural image caption generation model that is able to describe the content in an image by generating natural sentences.
the model can generate captions for images in the same style as human captions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
attention is not only a good way of visualizing the internal workings of a neural network, but can also be an effective tool in improving its performance.
attention is a powerful tool for modeling the interplay between the input image and the generated output sequence.
the attention model can be used to learn the spatial structure of images in a way that is useful for the task of image captioning.
